title: Weekly Harbor cutflow and changelog orchestrator
creator: Aisha Romero
description:
Problem: Our weekly release cut process has grown brittle as stacked changes, staggered LTS demarcations, and multiple RC variants (canary, stable, quantized) need consistent tagging and coordinated release notes. Manual steps to assemble changelogs and reconcile RC fingerprints across regions are error-prone and delay promotion windows.

Goal: Implement an orchestrator ("Harbor") that coordinates weekly snapshot cuts, deterministic RC tagging, and an automated changelog compiler. Harbor will:
- produce timeboxed weekly snapshots (UTC cutoff) with deterministic semantic-snapshot ids
- generate RC variants (canary/stable/quant) and annotate compatibility matrix
- run gating checks (smoke, e2e, perf quick-check) and surface failures to the release dashboard
- compile a machine-assisted changelog that groups commits by area, highlights customer-impacting changes, and links PRs/commits/runbooks
- emit artifacts (release manifest, fingerprint file, changelog draft) that downstream systems (deploy orchestrator, console deploy, partner sync) can consume

Non-goals: this ticket does not onboard the Private auto-upgrade flow or change retention policies for long-lived LTS branches (separate follow-up).
tasks: Design Harbor orchestrator API and CLI: spec endpoints for snapshot, tag, and publish
Implement deterministic snapshot generator using commit-lists + timestamp hashing
Add RC fingerprint file writer and validator (fingerprint includes model version, quant flags, kernel profile)
Wire in gating hooks: smoke runner, perf quick-check, and e2e smoke; each emits JSON status
Integrate changelog compiler: PR/commit scraper + NLP summarizer to reduce noise
Create release dashboard view and webhooks for failure notifications (PagerDuty/Slack)
Write runbook for manual interventions and rollback steps
Add end-to-end test scenario in CI that simulates staggered LTS demarcation and promotion
acceptance_criteria: Harbor can produce a weekly snapshot archive and deterministic snapshot id for a given cutoff UTC time
RC fingerprint file is generated and validated by the deploy pipeline; mismatches block promote
Changelog compiler outputs a draft Markdown file with grouped PRs, one-sentence AI summaries, and links to PRs/Confluence where applicable
Automated gating hooks run during cut and failures are recorded in the release dashboard with actionable logs
A canary promotion (canary -> stable) can be executed by a single CLI command using Harbor artifacts
Documentation and runbook published to Confluence and linked in the release dashboard
comments: 2025-11-06 10:12 - Aisha Romero: Initial writeup. Proposed name 'Harbor' to reflect a sheltered staging area for weekly snapshots. Assigned to Marcus for implementation plan.

2025-11-07 15:04 - Marcus Lee: Spike completed. Deterministic snapshot approach works using ordered commit list + cutoff timestamp hashed with SHA256. Edge case: force-pushes after cutoff can change commit set — planning to capture tree hashes as finalizing step.

2025-11-10 09:31 - SRE (Priya Shah): Gating hooks should include a lightweight perf quick-check that runs on a small representative model + 2 seq lengths. Will provide the runner image and metrics thresholds.
2025-11-12 16:50 - Product (Daniel Ortiz): Changelog AI summarizer is useful but must surface raw PR bodies and labels for audit. Keep a flag to disable NLP summaries for security-sensitive releases.

2025-11-15 11:20 - Marcus Lee: Implemented snapshot generator and fingerprint writer in branch feature/harbor/snapshot. Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1248. Need PR review on tag format. Requesting input on semver vs 'snapshot-YYYYMMDD-HHMM-hash'.

2025-11-18 14:05 - Engineering Manager (Lina Gupta): Prefer human-readable snapshot id with short hash suffix. Example: 20251118-utc-1200-hb3f9. Keep semantic versioning for release channels (1.20.0-rc1).

2025-11-19 08:42 - Security (Omar Khan): Confirmed no secrets are written to fingerprint files. Changelog compiler must not fetch private PR diffs unless token is explicitly scoped. Marking security_review_required=false for now.
2025-11-19 18:10 - Marcus Lee: Integrated perf quick-check; one failing case on a quantized variant. Filed ENG-30302 to triage kernel fallback. Will hold stable promotion until resolved.
notes: Decision: use weekly UTC cutoff at Tue 00:00 UTC to align with global ops windows
Trade-off: AI summarizer reduces manual curation but requires human review for PRs labeled 'security' or 'customer-impact'.
Follow-up: Hook Harbor artifacts into Dedicated capacity reserved deploy flow (separate ticket).
Risk: force-pushes between snapshot and fingerprint finalize step can introduce mismatch — mitigation: make fingerprint finalize step a protected action requiring release lead approval.
